bluf: LSEO is a founder led US agency founded 2014 that sells AI first SEO, GEO and paid media, promising brands rankings on Google and recommendations from AI on the strength of proprietary AI visibility software, LSEO AI and the Mention Engine. The record shows a house that practises every line it was tested on: an llms.txt, 708 AI topic URLs, 119 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and its own Google ad, and a 2026 US Search Awards finalist spot for AI search software. The one thing a rival should know: all 19 clients on record are names only, and the Horus read, Favored at 12.4, still marks its AI visibility product partial because no audited citation number shows.
doing:
LSEO positions itself as an AI first SEO, GEO and paid media agency helping brands get ranked by Google and recommended by AI, backed by proprietary AI visibility technology: in plain words, an SEO shop that has rebuilt its front end around AI answers and sells software alongside the service. Its headline claim is a finalist place in three 2026 US Search Awards categories, AI search software, B2B SEO and B2B PPC, including Best AI Search Software Solution; the about page adds that its experts have featured in The New York Times, Forbes, Bloomberg and The Today Show, and that the founder, Kristopher B. Jones, wrote SEO Visual Blueprint and built and sold Pepperjam to eBay. The record quotes these as claims.

The mix is twelve services, from GEO and AEO through SEO consulting, enterprise SEO, link building, content marketing and local SEO to paid media, Google Ads management, ChatGPT Ads management, WordPress design and branding. Two lines lead at 3. AI Search / GEO rests on GEO and AEO service pages, 13 industry GEO guides, 708 AI search URLs and the LSEO AI platform. SEO rests on a homepage title and H1 leading with AI powered SEO and enterprise, technical, ecommerce and local SEO pages. Two core lines score 2: Content & Digital PR on link building and content, with the GEO offer building third party brand mentions through the Mention Engine, and Paid Search on paid media in the title, Google Ads and ChatGPT Ads management and the B2B PPC finalist spot. Four proprietary assets are listed: LSEO AI, the LSEO Mention Engine, Visitor Intelligence and Best Of placements, a listicle of 10 Best Companies for a category. No partner is listed.

Its AI posture is the whole pitch: GEO and AEO services plus software to get brands cited and recommended by ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI; AI Automation / Agents scores 0.

Moves in date order: 2025-08, Jimmy T. Martin named the first CEO with the founder staying on as Founder; 2026, the three award finalist places. Pricing signals stop at a free first Best Of listicle placement and a free consultation, with no rates shown. Absent for an AI first shop of its kind: no case study describes the work behind any of 19 named clients, no jobs, no partner badge, and no office is listed.
clients:
The record marks its client type as mixed and lists twelve verticals: real estate, healthcare, legal, home services, SaaS and tech, ecommerce and retail, finance and professional services, education, manufacturing and industrial, automotive, hospitality and travel, and nonprofits. The home market is the US and no office is listed.

The book holds 19 clients and every one is a name only, 5 from case study pages and 14 from case study slugs on its our work section, none carrying a title or result the needs read could code, so each need is inferred from the AI search and SEO lines it leads with and the record does not say what any of them came for. The names run from national brands, Ring, ESPN and PayPal, through regional professional and medical practices, Legacy Advisors, Cooper Strategy, Moran Law, the Law Offices of Jason Provinzano, Bruno Plastic Surgery, PAK Pediatrics, Cawley Physical Therapy and Rehab and Geisinger Commonwealth School of Medicine, to product and home services businesses, Weigand, Nelson Home Group, Rockabilia, LUDECA, Ice Barrel, Homeowner Funding, Heller's Gas and Beleza na Web. The spread matches the mixed ICP tag: a few large logos and a long tail of local and mid market accounts.

One client sits on another tracked agency's book: PayPal also appears with razorfish.

What the base needs next is a judgment tied to the edition. KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) is the judgment it is best placed for, driven by AI Search / GEO and Content & Digital PR, so it is likely, with moderate confidence, that these clients ask for AI citation share as the measure next, which is the product it sells but has not shown audited in the record. KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out) is its exposure, driven by SEO, Paid Search and Content & Digital PR, so it is a roughly even chance that the long tail of local and professional accounts trims SEO hours first while the national logos hold.
house: The record marks 3 of 3 say and do lines practised and house integrity at 100, with no gap flagged. AI Search / GEO is corroborated: it publishes an llms.txt and holds 708 AI topic URLs in a sitemap of 2271, and blocks no AI crawlers. Paid Search is corroborated by its own Google ads, 1 in the Transparency Center and 1 in the last 30 days, a text ad under LSEO.com last shown 2026-09-27. Publishing cadence is corroborated by 119 sitemap URLs updated in 90 days and 427 in 365. The tag stack is ga4, google_ads and meta_pixel on WordPress with Elementor: a Meta pixel is present, no test tool or ABM stack shows, and no GTM container was detected. LinkedIn's ad library returned not found: 3 ads match the name query, all excluded as LSEO Labour Relations, leaving 0 company ads. No Meta or TikTok check is recorded. The social links are LinkedIn and Facebook.
market:
The Horus read puts LSEO at a tailwind index of 12.4, band Favored, resilience 33.9. It is best placed for KJ1 (the click is being replaced by the citation) at net 0.383, driven by AI Search / GEO and Content & Digital PR with SEO pulling against, and for KJ2 (ads inside AI answers) at 0.273 on AI Search / GEO and Paid Search; it is most exposed to KJ6 (the agency middle is being hollowed out) at -0.295, driven by SEO, Paid Search and Content & Digital PR, and to KJ4 at -0.164. The mix sits at 16:43 on the Solar Arc, dusk (Atum), and the best scenario fit is The Toll Road at 44/100. It is partial on P1 (audited AI visibility, since no tracking, scorecard or citation share shows despite the platform), P4 (inputs for automation) and P8 (it talks ads inside assistants with no incrementality or holdout capability); P2, P3, P6 and P7 are absent; P5 is unknown.

The Monsoon read is 60.5, band Onshore wind, migration 59.0 against displacement 62.0, inferred from the mixed ICP term. 59 of the index is the sold mix, SEO (17) and AI Search / GEO (9) most movable; the shore split sends 65% to South and Southeast Asia and 25% to Latin America. No hub office or onshore claim is listed, so the footprint is inferred.
openings:
The strongest opening is the number. It sells AI visibility software and a Mention Engine, yet the Horus read marks P1 partial because no audited citation share, scorecard or tracking shows in the record, so it is likely, with moderate confidence, that a rival opening with an audited AI citation number for a named client wins the GEO conversation against a shop whose evidence is 708 topic pages and an award shortlist. The falsifier is a captured LSEO AI page or case study showing a tracked citation number for a named client.

The book is the second opening: 19 of 19 clients are names without described work, so Ring, ESPN and PayPal, the last already shared with razorfish, are contestable on evidence of work, and the long tail of legal, medical and home services names is contestable on price, since displacement 62.0 on the Monsoon read says the mixed book buys on rate and an offshore delivered rival can undercut SEO hours line by line, an inferred read.

The move gaps are P2, no feed, schema or entity work on a core search line, so the machine readable layer answer engines consume is unclaimed by an AI first shop; P4 partial, paid media run without first party data, creative volume or measurement depth; and P5 unknown, so a transparent outcome priced offer is a conversation it cannot have in public. The KJ6 exposure makes its SEO and content hours the ones the hollowed out middle removes.
watch: Indicator I2, Alphabet Q3 2026 search growth and AI Mode ad disclosures, next reading late October 2026: growth below 10% flags cannibalization of its SEO line, while above 15% with AI Mode ads live confirms S1 and its whole AI first pitch.

Indicator I10, Reddit US daily users against search referral volatility, next reading late October 2026: US DAUq growth at or below 5% alongside AI Mode growth confirms the UGC starvation risk behind KJ1.

Indicator I8, holdco Q3 organic growth, headcount and pricing model disclosures, next reading October 2026: output or outcome pricing announced at a top five holdco would sharpen its KJ6 exposure while its own pricing stays a free consultation.

Indicator I3, OpenAI ad run rate disclosures and CPM trend, rolling: the $2B milestone and pricing below $20 CPM would tell whether its ChatGPT Ads management line, P8 partial, gets a market to test in.

Follow up the dated moves: the first CEO named 2025-08 and the 2026 US Search Awards finalist places, since a result in the AI search software category would give the platform claim its first external test.
